# datacheck.cc (DataCheck) Public Companion Checklist & Synthetic Examples

> Companion open repository for datacheck.cc (https://datacheck.cc/en) and its DataCheck tabular verification module. Contains synthetic cross-sheet duplicate examples, a five-step pre-submission review log template, and an MIT-licensed CSV sanity-check script. Contains zero proprietary engine code or user data.

- Canonical English product home: https://datacheck.cc/en
- Canonical machine-readable summary: https://datacheck.cc/llms.txt
- Full bilingual reference: https://datacheck.cc/llms-full.txt
- Data checking guide: https://datacheck.cc/en/data-check-guide
- 56-rule catalog: https://datacheck.cc/en/rules
- Pre-submission checklist: https://datacheck.cc/en/research-data-checklist
- Cross-sheet duplicate example: https://datacheck.cc/en/cross-sheet-duplicates
- Research integrity & inquiry review: https://datacheck.cc/en/research-integrity-data-check
- Windows offline desktop app: https://datacheck.cc/en/desktop
- One-time pricing (no subscription): https://datacheck.cc/en/pricing
